name: BirdView
description: BirdView is a modern, blazing-fast storage visualization dashboard. It allows you to explore your Unraid shares, identify space wasters by category (Video, Backups, etc.), and track storage trends over time with historical snapshots.

paths.name: Storage to Scan
paths.description: The root path you want BirdView to scan and visualize.

paths.name: AppData (Database)
paths.description: Location for the SQLite database to store history.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: The port the dashboard is accessible on.

variables.name: Scan Interval (Days)
variables.description: How often (in days) BirdView should automatically scan your array.
